description: Open-source, self-hosted, code-bridged infinite canvas design platform inspired by Paper.design

tasks.title: Initialize project with Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS and Paper Design System Tokens
tasks.description: Setup clean React TypeScript project in app/ with Tailwind v4 or v3, configure Paper design tokens (palette: #edebe1, #080808, #81adec, #4c8eef, #222222, typography: Matter/Inter, grid: 120px ticks, vertex squares). Install @paper-design/shaders-react and lucide-react.

tasks.title: Build high-performance 60fps Infinite Canvas Engine with pan/zoom and viewport matrix transforms
tasks.description: Implement CanvasViewport with world-to-screen and screen-to-world coordinate transforms, smooth zoom (wheel/trackpad), infinite pan (space+drag / middle click), minimap / zoom level indicator (10% to 3200%), and hardware-accelerated rendering loop.
tasks.verification_cmd: cd /root/projects/paper/app && npm test || npm run build

tasks.title: Implement Paper Engineering Grid, Top/Side Rulers, and Vertex Markers
tasks.description: Render adaptive grid lines (120px major divisions, sub-ticks), precise pixel rulers along top and left edges synced with canvas pan/zoom, and vertex corner squares matching Paper aesthetic.

tasks.title: Implement Scene Graph Data Model and Core Elements (Frames, Rects, Ellipses, Text, Paths)
tasks.description: Build state store (Zustand or custom observable) managing canvas elements: Frame (artboard container), Rectangle, Ellipse, Vector Path, Text, Image. Support hierarchy, z-index, visibility, locking, and basic styling (fill, stroke, opacity, shadow).
tasks.verification_cmd: cd /root/projects/paper/app && npm test || npm run build

tasks.title: Build Selection, Dragging, Resize Handles, Rotation, and Smart Snapping
tasks.description: Implement selection box (drag to marquee select), single and multi-select bounding box with 8 resize handles, rotation handle, cursor changes, and smart alignment guides (snap to center, edges, and distances with visual guide lines).

tasks.title: Integrate Paper Shaders Engine (MeshGradient, Halftone, Gooey, Dithering, Noise)
tasks.description: Connect @paper-design/shaders-react so any shape or canvas background can have animated or static Paper Shaders (Mesh Gradient, Dot Orbit, Grain Gradient, Halftone CMYK, Neuro Noise) with live parameter controls in inspector panel.

tasks.title: Build Dev Mode Inspector and Production Code Generator (React + Tailwind)
tasks.description: Implement Dev Mode toggle: clicking elements displays CSS properties, box model, tokens, and generates clean production-ready React + Tailwind CSS code (copyable with one click), matching Paper's bridge between design and code.

tasks.title: Implement Export (PNG, SVG, JSON) and Import (Figma / SVG paste support)
tasks.description: Support exporting selected frames or whole canvas as crisp SVG and high-DPI PNG. Implement JSON project serialization / file save. Add clipboard paste handler allowing pasting SVG and HTML elements directly onto canvas.

tasks.title: Create Production Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml for Single-Command Self-Hosting
tasks.description: Build multi-stage production Dockerfile (lightweight Node/Alpine or Nginx static server), write docker-compose.yml with volume persistence for projects, configure healthchecks and environment variables.

tasks.title: Implement Playwright E2E Visual Verification Tests
tasks.description: Write Playwright tests in e2e/ verifying canvas mounting, pan/zoom responsiveness, shape creation, shader rendering, selection bounding box, and screenshot capture for regression prevention.

tasks.title: Implement Pen / Vector Path Editor with Bezier curve handles and point editing
tasks.description: Add interactive Vector Pen tool (P): click to add anchor points, drag for Bezier control handles, double-click on path to enter vector editing mode with draggable node handles, matching Paper vector editing specs.

tasks.title: Implement Command-Pattern History Stack (Undo/Redo with Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z)
tasks.description: Implement immutable/command history stack supporting up to 100 checkpoints for element mutation, transform, layer ordering, and styling changes with undo/redo toolbar buttons and keyboard shortcuts.

tasks.phase: Phase 11: Paper Native MCP Server Integration
tasks.title: Build Standalone Paper MCP Server exposing design schema to AI agents
tasks.description: Implement /root/projects/paper/mcp-server with stdio MCP protocol exposing tools: get_canvas_elements, create_frame, add_shader_shape, update_element, export_selection. Allows Claude, Codex, and Cursor to read/write Paper canvas files.
